[Bm]Scattering [D]petals down the

[Chorus]
[Bm]"Oh Mary, [D]contrary
[Bm]how does your [D]garden grow?"

[G]anywhere that [F#m]we could go"

[G]as darkness [F#m]swallowed them up
[Bm]One more time, [D]I'll be fine,
[G]sometimes kindness [F#m]is enough
[C#m]"Oh Mary, [E]contrary
[A]how does your [G#m]garden grow?"
[C#m]"Don't leave me, [E]please don't be
[A]the seventh maid [G#m]in a row"
[C#m]My answer [E]a whisper
[A]soft as he [G#m]lowered his head
